## Sand Trap — G4 *Friendship Is Magic*

**Who he is:** The elderly, hard-of-hearing Earth-pony stallion who cuts ahead of Fluttershy at the asparagus stand and misunderstands her complaint. Recognize his tan coat, emerald-green eyes, two-tone gray/white mane and tail, and golf-club-and-two-balls cutie mark. [Character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sand_Trap).

- **Naming:** Unnamed on television; fans and the wiki previously called him **“Geri.”** IDW's *Ponyville Mysteries* #3 (July 18, 2018) gives him the **published name Sand Trap**. In that comic, he is wrongly suspected of the retirement-village fire. [Wiki rename history](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Forum:Bot_to-do_list) · [Comic synopsis and creators](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Ponyville_Mysteries_Issue_3).
- **Speaking:** **Yes.** In *Putting Your Hoof Down* (S2E19), he speaks to Fluttershy through an ear trumpet and confuses “cut in front” with “a cut of celery.” [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Putting_Your_Hoof_Down). IMDb attributes his **uncredited English voice** (under “Geri”) to **Richard Ian Cox**; this is not an independently verified on-screen credit. [Cast attribution](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt2230279/characters/nm0185214).
- **Spot him:** Plays chess with Apple Bloom in *The Cutie Pox*; is among the seniors rescued from a collapsing balcony in *The Mysterious Mare Do Well*; appears **younger** in *The Perfect Pear* flashbacks; and naps, then windsurfs, at the retirement community in *The Point of No Return*. A corresponding **human design** appears in *Equestria Girls: Friendship Games*; that is the parallel-world counterpart, not a disguise.
